artboards.title: RNA-Seq analysis steps - raw reads to a count table

annotations.text:
Redraw of img/alignment5.png, used on the site in week04/w4a_genomics-files.qmd. Export at 1400x1270 (2x) and replace that file.

Same visual grammar as img/hts-applications.png, and built from the same helpers (design/hts-applications/geom.mjs, Source Sans Pro embedded): reads are ONE neutral slate everywhere, and colour marks only what a step acts on - red for the junk trimming removes, blue/teal for the two genes alignment assigns reads to. That is a change from the original, where reads were already blue/magenta before alignment.

Stages 1 and 2 draw the SAME reads at the SAME positions: stage 2 just shortens the trimmed ones and drops the two that were junk end to end, so the eye sees reads being cleaned up rather than a new random scatter.

The pileup is drawn to the count table: exactly 8 blue reads over Gene A and 9 teal over Gene B, matching Sample 1. Sample 2 (15 / 7) is not drawn, so it stays grey.

Colours are from theme_web.scss - #bb0000 primary, #0072B2 blue, #009E73 teal. Everything is regenerated by `node gen.mjs`; edit that rather than the artboard if the geometry needs to change.
